component.name: DonutRadio
component.summary: Internet radio without ads or talk

description.p: DonutRadio plays internet radio stations picked for having no ads and no talk. It streams through its own audio engine, so the spectrum visualizer reads the same audio you hear.
Browse stations by genre, save favorites, and set the volume. A matching widget for KDE Plasma 6 is available.
Free Radio is now DonutRadio. Playback runs on a built-in audio engine with a pinned LGPL FFmpeg, and the Plasma widget installs with the app.
